EXPORT_NAME A20N

# X-CSL style: two objects, colon and backslash package forms
OBJ8_AIRCRAFT A20N_A20NAAF
OBJ8 SOLID YES A20N:A20NCFMfan.obj
OBJ8 SOLID YES A20N\A20NCFM_AAF.obj
VERT_OFFSET 0.0
AIRLINE A20N AAF

# Slash form plus an object from another package (global EXPORT_NAME map)
OBJ8_AIRCRAFT A20N_SHARED
OBJ8 SOLID YES A20N/A20NCFM_AAF.obj
OBJ8 SOLID YES SharedParts:wheels.obj
VERT_OFFSET 1.5
ICAO A20N

# Unknown package and missing file: both lines dropped, so the model is dropped
OBJ8_AIRCRAFT A20N_BROKEN
OBJ8 SOLID YES NoSuchPkg:x.obj
OBJ8 SOLID YES A20N:missing.obj
ICAO A20N

# No VERT_OFFSET: derived from the OBJ's lowest vertex
OBJ8_AIRCRAFT A20N_NOVO
OBJ8 SOLID YES A20N:lowpoint.obj
ICAO A20N

# Alternate livery: numbered code = special scheme
OBJ8_AIRCRAFT A20N_A20NAAF2
OBJ8 SOLID YES A20N:A20NCFMfan.obj
OBJ8 SOLID YES A20N\A20NCFM_AAF.obj
VERT_OFFSET 0.0
LIVERY A20N AAF 2

# Standard livery on another airframe variant (winglets): not special
OBJ8_AIRCRAFT A20N_A20NAAFWL
OBJ8 SOLID YES A20N:A20NCFMfan.obj
OBJ8 SOLID YES A20N\A20NCFM_AAF.obj
VERT_OFFSET 0.0
LIVERY A20N AAF WL
